column1: # EasyVbox ISO catalog
# Data file used by `--list-isos` and `--download NAME`. One entry per line,
# fields separated by `|`. Lines starting with `#` and blank lines are ignored.
#   name | family | size_gb | checksums_url | file_pattern | direct_url | checksum_url | notes
# How an entry is resolved:
#   * If `file_pattern` is set, EasyVbox downloads `checksums_url` (a plain
#     SHA256SUMS-style file), finds the line containing the pattern, and takes
#     both the checksum and the file name from it. The ISO is then fetched from
#     the same directory as `checksums_url`. This is the robust mode: the
#     filename follows the upstream point release automatically.
#   * Otherwise `direct_url` is used as-is. If `checksum_url` is set it must
#     contain a SHA-256 hex digest (optionally followed by the file name).
# `size_gb` is an approximate download size, shown by `--list-isos`.
# These are official upstream locations, but they do change: if an entry stops
# working, fix the line here, or use `--download https://.../image.iso` for a
# one-off. Windows evaluation images are intentionally not listed because their
# download links are generated per request and expire.
